text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Derby approaching, Agnes 
Tachyon spent her days diligently 
training—an unusual sight for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Manhattan Cafe points out that 
her running form has changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer presses her about her changed 
running style, but she smoothly dodges the 
question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though anxiety and doubts remained... the 
journey toward the grand early-summer 
stage had begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, simply because she didn't 
feel like it, she ended up changing her 
race from the Japanese Derby to the NHK 
Mile Cup.
